on GenerateResponseSchema
	 local tPayload,tSchema,tFormat,tStepItem,tJSONBody,tQuestionItemSchema
	 
	 // BUILD RESPONSE FORMAT
	 put "json_schema" into tFormat["type"]
	 
	 // DEFINE QUESTION ITEM SCHEMA
	 put "object" into tQuestionItemSchema["type"]
	 put false into tQuestionItemSchema["additionalProperties"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 1: SEQID
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["SeqID"]["type"]
	 put "The sequence ID of the question. Whole numbers: 1,2,etc * Nested numbers: 1.1,1.2,etc. *'Conditional' examples: 2a,2b,3.1a,etc." into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["SeqID"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 2: QUESTIONTEXT
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["QuestionText"]["type"]
	 put "Text of the question presented to the learner" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["QuestionText"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 3: FULLQUESTIONTEXT
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["FullQuestionText"]["type"]
	 put "ONLY for Fill In The Blank questions - this contains the complete sentence or statement WITHOUT any blanks (______). This is the reference version showing the full text. Example: if the fill-in question is 'The capital of ______ is Paris', then FullQuestionText would be 'The capital of France is Paris'. For Multiple Choice, True/False, and Written questions, this field MUST be left empty (empty string). Do not put blanks (______) in this property." into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["FullQuestionText"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 4: QUESTIONTYPE
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["QuestionKind"]["type"]
	 put "Allowed values: 'True / False', 'Multiple Choice', 'Fill In', or 'Written'. 'Written' response questions are short form questions that are answered in paragraphs or sentences." into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["QuestionKind"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 5: QUESTIONMODE
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["QuestionMode"]["type"]
	 put "Hierarchy flag: 'Null', 'Has Nested', 'Is Nested', 'Has Conditional' or 'Is Conditional'" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["QuestionMode"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 6: ANSWERS
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["Answers"]["type"]
	 put "Multiple Choice answers, one per line. Each line is a choice in order: first line is 'A', second is 'B', and so on. Do NOT include the letter in the answer text." into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["Answers"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 7: CORRECTANSWER
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["CorrectAnswer"]["type"]
	 put "Canonical correct answer. For 'Multiple Choice', this must be the choice key only (e.g., 'A', 'B', etc). Do not include the answer text. For 'True / False', use 'True' or 'False'. For 'Written', if required, list aspects of the correct answer—one per line. For 'Fill In' questions: CRITICAL - you MUST use exactly one line per blank. Each line contains acceptable answers separated by pipe (|). If there are 3 blanks, there MUST be exactly 3 lines. Example for 2 blanks: Line 1: 'violet|purple' Line 2: 'yellow|orange'. Never put all answers on one line for Fill In questions." into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["CorrectAnswer"]["description"]
	
	 // PROPERTY 8: DEPENDSON
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["DependsOn"]["type"]
	 put "Conditional logic object specifying the ID and value that must be satisfied before this question is shown" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["DependsOn"]["description"]
	 
	 // PROPERTY 9: STATE STANDARD
	 put "string" into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["StateStandard"]["type"]
	 put "What state standard would this question fall under? When listing the standard, for example,  do not type out 'California', but instead use 'CA-'.  The state the teacher teaches in is signified by 'Region/State in your prompt." into tQuestionItemSchema["properties"]["StateStandard"]["description"]
	 
	
	 // REQUIRED FIELDS FOR EACH QUESTION
	 put "SeqID" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][1]
	 put "QuestionText" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][2]
	 put "FullQuestionText" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][3]
	 put "QuestionKind" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][4]
	 put "QuestionMode" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][5]
	 put "CorrectAnswer" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][6]
	 put "Answers" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][7]
	 put "DependsOn" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][8]
	 put "StateStandard" into tQuestionItemSchema["required"][9]
	 // MAIN WRAPPER SCHEMA
	 put "object" into tSchema["type"]
	 put false into tSchema["additionalProperties"]
	 
	 // MESSAGE KEY
	 put "string" into tSchema["properties"]["message"]["type"]
	 put "Message to display before or instead of a quiz" into tSchema["properties"]["message"]["description"]
	
	 // Quiz Length
	 put "string" into tSchema["properties"]["quiz length"]["type"]
	 put "Estimated Number of minutes the generated quiz questions will take to complete. Only return the number of minutes no other words." into tSchema["properties"]["quiz length"]["description"]
	 
	 // OPTIONAL QUESTIONS ARRAY
	 put "array" into tSchema["properties"]["questions"]["type"]
	 put tQuestionItemSchema into tSchema["properties"]["questions"]["items"]
	 
	 // REQUIRED FIELDS FOR MAIN WRAPPER
	 put "message" into tSchema["required"][1]
	 put "questions" into tSchema["required"][2]
	put "quiz length" into tSchema["required"][3]
	 
	 // EMBED INTO FORMAT
	 put "quiz_structure" into tFormat["json_schema"]["name"]
	 put true into tFormat["json_schema"]["strict"]
	 put tSchema into tFormat["json_schema"]["schema"]
	 
	 // ASSIGN TO PAYLOAD
	 put tFormat into quizliAIResponseSchema
	// put arrayToJSON(quizliAIResponseSchema,,true)
end GenerateResponseSchema
